speaker: Unknown
en: And when you have hundreds of thousands of GPUs running models, load balancing and routing becomes an issue.
zh: 而当你有几十万块 GPU 在跑模型时,负载均衡和路由就成了一个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a lot of the time, people say, well, that's easy, right?
zh: 所以很多时候,人们会说,这很简单,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: We just put a load balancer in front, send traffic randomly to different GPUs.
zh: 我们只要在前面放一个负载均衡器,把流量随机发到不同的 GPU 上就行。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not how it works in LLMs, because the workloads are slightly different.
zh: 但在 LLM 上不是这样工作的,因为工作负载稍有不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, just to give you an idea, in the early days of LLM, the inputs were small.
zh: 举个例子,让你们有个概念,在 LLM 早期,输入很小。

speaker: Unknown
en: I could just say write like a one-liner, and the output is all small.
zh: 我可能只说一句让它写个一行代码,输出也都很小。

speaker: Unknown
en: But now we are seeing your input could be pretty large.
zh: 但现在我们看到输入可能相当大。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are sending large code bases using coding agents to do refactor or summarize or analyze.
zh: 我们在用 coding agent 发送大型代码库去做重构、总结或分析。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the output, as you can see, can vary from large to small, large to large.
zh: 所以输出,如你所见,可以大到小、大到大多样变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And routing them accordingly will give you...
zh: 相应地做路由会给你……

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not trivial.
zh: 这不是件小事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what we employ is we employ routers that actually are cache aware.
zh: 所以我们采用的是真正具备缓存感知能力的路由器。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I mean by that is like if you look at the left side here, you will see that my cache, like different colors, is kind of fragmented all over.
zh: 我的意思是,比如你看左边的图,你会看到我的缓存,用不同颜色表示,基本上是碎片化散落各处的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So our caching rate isn't all that great because my request is landing randomly at different GPUs that may or may not have the cache.
zh: 所以我们的缓存命中率不太好,因为我的请求随机落在不同的 GPU 上,而这些 GPU 可能有缓存也可能没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you look at the one on the right, you can see that now the cache is much more coherent.
zh: 但如果你看右边那张图,可以看到现在缓存连贯多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: See the colors are kind of together.
zh: 看颜色基本是聚在一起的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the router knows where the caches are stored, and it will route them accordingly.
zh: 路由器知道缓存存在哪里,并且会相应地路由。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when you actually do the inference, you get pretty good cache and very good speed.
zh: 所以当你实际做推理时,你能获得很好的缓存和非常快的速度。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another thing, and this is something we are really excited about, it's called spec decoding.
zh: 另一件事,这是我们非常兴奋的东西,叫做 spec decoding。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the challenge is LLMs, they generate tokens one by one.
zh: 挑战在于 LLM 是一个接一个地生成 token 的。

speaker: Unknown
en: One, two, three, four, right?
zh: 一、二、三、四,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then large models take a long time to generate these tokens.
zh: 而大模型生成这些 token 需要很长时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the idea for spec decoding is how about we employ a smaller model, which is a lot of the time faster and cheaper, to generate the tokens.
zh: 所以 spec decoding 的想法是,我们用一个更小的模型来生成 token,它很多时候更快也更便宜,怎么样?

speaker: Unknown
en: But then have the large model verify at the end.
zh: 但最后让大模型来验证。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's kind of like if you're like a senior engineer, you're kind of farming out the work to a junior engineer, so they're kind of doing the heavy lifting, and then you are verifying the work.
zh: 这有点像你是高级工程师,把工作分派给初级工程师,让他们干重活,然后你来验证工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this actually surprisingly scales really well.
zh: 而这实际上出人意料地扩展性很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the smaller models can generate tokens very quickly, and the large model can verify, and if it's good, we are done.
zh: 小模型可以非常快地生成 token,大模型可以验证,如果没问题,就完成了。

speaker: Unknown
en: If a large model doesn't like the answer, it will actually regenerate the tokens for you.
zh: 如果大模型不满意这个答案,它会重新生成这些 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's kind of the worst-case scenario.
zh: 所以那算是最坏的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: But most of the time, you will get pretty good performance out of this by mixing in small models and large models.
zh: 但大多数时候,通过混合使用小模型和大模型,你能获得相当不错的性能。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of the things we experimented, we sort of trained draft models.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: But it gets even better if you can train the smaller model using your own data.
zh: 但如果你能用你自己的数据来训练这个小模型,效果还会更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we did a lot of experiments here.
zh: 所以我们在这里做了很多实验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And launching a feature, you can actually train these draft models almost like with one click.
zh: 我们在上线一个功能,你几乎可以一键训练这些 draft 模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we will capture your production data and train the draft models for you, which is pretty cool.
zh: 我们会捕获你的生产数据并为你训练 draft 模型,这相当酷。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another optimization behind the scenes is KVCache.
zh: 另一个幕后的优化是 KVCache。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is probably one of the biggest ROI in doing inference because creating tokens is expensive, especially when you're doing one at a time.
zh: 这可能是做推理时投资回报率最高的优化之一,因为生成 token 很昂贵,尤其是当你一次只生成一个的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the common sense is once you generate a token, it doesn't change.
zh: 常识是,一旦生成了一个 token,它就不会改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there's no need to keep regenerating the same token over and over again.
zh: 所以没必要一次又一次地重复生成同一个 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the idea is we cache the tokens.
zh: 所以我们的想法是把这些 token 缓存起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: So just to kind of give an example here, let's say this is my prompt, the cat sat on, right?
zh: 这里举个例子,假设这是我的提示词,"the cat sat on",对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's say those are my prompt, and I'm creating the next word.
zh: 假设那些是我的提示词,我正在生成下一个词。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as soon as we create the next token, we cache it.
zh: 而一旦我们生成了下一个 token,我们就把它缓存起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the next time we need to look up, we don't have to regenerate it.
zh: 下次需要查找时,我们不必重新生成它。

speaker: Unknown
en: We just look up the cache.
zh: 那非常消耗 CPU。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very easy.
zh: 非常简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this actually speeds up quite a bit.
zh: 而这实际上能带来相当大的加速。

speaker: Unknown
en: So just to kind of give you some ideas, we are seeing speed ups anywhere from 5 to 10x.
zh: 给大家一些概念,我们看到的加速从 5 倍到 10 倍不等。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not just 5 to 10%, actually 10x, right?
zh: 不只是 5% 到 10%,实际上是 10 倍,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because caching really works well.
zh: 因为缓存真的很有效。

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing about caching is it takes a lot of memory, right?
zh: 缓存的问题在于它占用很多内存,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because, you know, especially with our large inputs and large token windows.
zh: 因为,你知道,尤其是我们的输入很大、token 窗口很大的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one thing we've been implementing in Token Factory is
zh: 我们在 Token Factory 里一直在实现的一件事是——

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we do caching.
zh: 当我们做缓存的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can actually, because GPU memory is very precious, so we can offload caching out of GPU memory automatically, save it in a regular memory, and then bring it back.
zh: 我们实际上可以,因为 GPU 内存非常宝贵,所以可以自动把缓存从 GPU 内存卸载出去,保存到普通内存里,然后再搬回来。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we don't throw away the cache we spend a lot of time building.
zh: 这样我们就不会扔掉花费大量时间构建的缓存。

speaker: Unknown
en: We actually offload it and bring it back.
zh: 我们实际上把它卸载出去,再搬回来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of this is done automatically.
zh: 而这一切都是自动完成的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you don't have to worry about managing cache.
zh: 所以你不必操心管理缓存。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is done for you behind the scenes.
zh: 这些都是在幕后为你完成的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is one of the important optimizations we have done to speed up inference.
zh: 这是我们为加速推理所做的重要优化之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another one is called decoding.
zh: 另一个叫做解码。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the way you think about this is like there are two stages to LLMs.
zh: 你可以这样想,LLM 有两个阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of them is like sort of fill in the context.
zh: 其中一个有点像填充上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is very CPU intensive.
zh: 这是非常消耗 CPU 的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And another one is actually decoding that is very memory intensive.
zh: 另一个实际上是解码,非常消耗内存。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a lot of the time, if you do them in the same GPU, they are kind of computing for resources.
zh: 很多时候,如果你在同一个 GPU 上做这两件事,它们会互相争抢资源。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what we have done, we sort of separate those two phases out.
zh: 所以我们做的就是把这两个阶段分开。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one GPU set does pre-fill.
zh: 一组 GPU 做 pre-fill(预填充)。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are very, you know, compute efficient.
zh: 它们非常,你知道,计算高效。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the other one does decoding that's very memory efficient.
zh: 另一组做解码,非常内存高效。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then they sort of transfer the KV cache in between.
zh: 然后它们之间会传输 KV cache。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have seen this is actually working out pretty well.
zh: 我们看到这个方案实际效果相当不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: And another thing we do, and this is already baked into our platform, we also quantize the models.
zh: 我们做的另一件事,这已经内置到我们的平台里了,我们还会对模型做量化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when we do quantizing, we are reducing the position.
zh: 当我们做量化时,我们在降低精度。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we don't want to go too far, right?
zh: 但我们不想做得太过头,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because then your model starts, quality starts getting degrading.
zh: 因为那样你的模型质量就开始下降了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what we do is we do a lot of experiments to figure out what's the sweet spot of quantization so you can run the models efficiently, but not degrade the performance too much.
zh: 所以我们做的是大量实验,找出量化的最佳平衡点,这样你既能高效运行模型,又不会让性能下降太多。

speaker: Unknown
en: So all of these things are already built in, and there's a few more, and in the interest of time, I'll wrap this up here.
zh: 所有这些都已经内置了,还有一些更多内容,为了节省时间,我就到这里收尾。

speaker: Unknown
en: And these are some of the things we kind of covered, spec decoding, KV cache, and when you do caching, doing routing, that is actually cache aware, and also separating pre-fill and decoding cases.
zh: 这些就是我们大致讲到的东西,投机解码、KV cache,还有做缓存时进行真正缓存感知的路由,以及把 pre-fill 和解码分开。

speaker: Unknown
